item.invasion.rift_flux.desc: Energy tapped from the nexus rift. Generated by an active Nexus; craft it into useful materials.
item.invasion.small_remnants.desc: Dropped by invaders. Nine make a Rift Flux.
item.invasion.nexus_catalyst.desc: Put into a Nexus to start an invasion at wave 1.
item.invasion.stable_catalyst_mixture.de: Smelt into a Stable Nexus Catalyst.
item.invasion.stable_nexus_catalyst.desc: Put into a Nexus to start continuous mode: night attacks every few days, Rift Flux generation.
item.invasion.strong_catalyst.desc: Starts an invasion at wave 10. Made by putting Rift Flux into a Nexus of level 10 or higher.
item.invasion.damping_agent.desc: Keep it in a Nexus in continuous mode to stop its power from rising.
item.invasion.strong_damping_agent.desc: Keep it in a Nexus in continuous mode to drain its power and shut it down.
item.invasion.strange_bone.desc: Give it to a tamed wolf near a Nexus to make it a Nexus guardian.
item.invasion.infused_sword.desc: Charges with every hit. When full, use it to heal (sneak: restore hunger).
item.invasion.searing_bow.desc: Hold it drawn for a long time to release a searing shot.
item.invasion.nexus_adjuster.desc: Use on an inactive Nexus to change its spawn radius (sneak to decrease).
item.invasion.material_probe.desc: Shows block strength against invaders, adjusts a Nexus and picks up armed traps.
item.invasion.empty_trap.desc: Put it into a Nexus to fold a Rift Trap, or craft it with lava into a Flame Trap.
item.invasion.rift_trap.desc: Place on the ground. Deals massive damage to whatever steps on it.
item.invasion.flame_trap.desc: Place on the ground. Sets everything around it on fire.
